items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: Like, I got the nicest telegram from William Paley.

ctx.x: Yeah. Well, as a rule, like I tell you, every time... During those years, every time I'd set up shop in a joint, I would get some air time. Because I would get so good on there... That's another thing. I really should have been way ahead of what was going on for me, with all the air time I had then. You know, the feedback I got from it. Like, I got the nicest telegram from William Paley. And every time I'd set up shop anywhere, right away they'd want to put a wire on me, you know.

So we had a broadcast from Terasi's. We got that in there. I didn't get it in there. Tommy Reynolds, he dogged me and he wanted to put it in there, so he put it in there. So one night... This (?) used to be either a Baron or a Count, one of the two. I'm not talking about Timme. He came in there, and they wanted Zutty to play his solo on "Tiger Rag." So I said, "You want ...(?)... after mine?" He said, "I don't want to play that." So I didn't play it!
